a.lede: Elon Musk may prefer FEL light sources for in-house chip production, but Terafab will start with proven tech from ASML.
a.title: Elon Musk's Terafab will reportedly receive its first EUV tool from ASML in mid-2027

b.lede: TSMC's management confirms that the company is looking forward to expand U.S. capacity beyond Arizona and Texas is one of its options. However, to become a part of the Terafab project, it insists on running the whole fab.
b.title: TSMC confirms it is considering Terafab chipmaking expansion with Elon Musk
